elements.name: UserDTO
elements.role: Request and response data transfer object representing user details.

elements.name: LibraryFacade
elements.role: Defines the primary API entry point for system operations including user registration.

elements.name: UserRegistry
elements.role: Persistence access layer for users and student/librarian accounts.

elements.name: UserManager
elements.role: Domain service coordinating user registration, validation, role-specific data handling, and authentication.

notes: RI-1: Externally visible operations include register(String role, String name, String surname, String email, String password, String identifier) in LibraryFacade.
RI-2: Request parameters are passed via primitive strings (role, name, surname, email, password, identifier), and response is wrapped in UserDTO.
RI-3: Operation that realizes user registration functionality is LibraryFacade.register() delegating to UserManager.register().
AQ1: Primary API entry point is LibraryFacade.register(String role, String name, String surname, String email, String password, String identifier), returning a UserDTO.
AQ2: UserManager receives the registration request and coordinates validation, role-specific data handling, and persistence via UserRegistry.

AQ3: Call chain for successful registration: LibraryFacade.register -> UserManager.register -> validate / validateStudent / validateLibrarian -> UserFactory.createUser -> UserRegistry.registerUser -> returns UserDTO.

AQ4: Branching and error paths handle invalid roles, malformed names, invalid institutional email formats (must match unina.it), password constraints (8-32 chars), duplicate email checks, duplicate identifier checks, and persistence failures throwing IllegalArgumentException or RuntimeException.
AQ5: Implemented in LibraryFacade.java, UserManager.java, UserRegistry.java, UserDTO.java, StudentFactory.java, LibrarianFactory.java, Student.java, Librarian.java, and User.java.
